title: Public PPL tariffs
lead: What common actions on People's Blockchain cost. Every fee is paid in PPL, the network's own coin.
approvedNote: These are the prices the site uses today. The wallet always shows the exact fee before you sign.

table.note: Sending PPL or a token to someone
Paid in advance when you publish or use a contract
A simple token contract (about 1,200,000 gas units)

contractNote: The exact cost depends on how large the contract is. You choose a gas limit before signing; gas you don't use is not returned.
modelANote: Every protocol fee is split: 30% to validators, 25% to the community pool, 20% to the treasury, 10% to liquidity, 15% to Growth, 0% burned — including fractional fees.
payOptionsNote: Token and NFT creation fees can be paid in PPL, or in a supported testnet stablecoin (tUSDC/tUSDT) through the StableFeeGateway contract — your choice. The stablecoin fee is a fixed, owner-approved USD amount: 5.00 USD for a token launch, 10.00 USD for an NFT mint. 100% of every stablecoin fee goes to the public PPL buyback, and the bought-back PPL is then split 30/25/20/10/15 by the treasury multisig, same as every other buyback. Gas is always paid in PPL.
stableFeeNetworkNote: Stablecoin payment works on the People network only for now. Paying from another chain (Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, TON, Solana) is coming later.
growthReferralBody: 15% of eligible protocol fees fund the Growth Pool. When Growth rewards settle, two paid referral lines share that budget: L1 at 70% and L2 at 30%. This is separate from the 10% token community allocation and from ordinary fee routing to validators and the Community Pool.
